title: pm-dispatch SKILL: give the objectui local backlog its own target:v17 producer (release-board coverage gap)
body:
## Background — the gap, measured on 2026-08-09

The release board (`target:v17`) has exactly one producer: the objectstack triage seat, whose step-0 sweep is deliberately repo-scoped to objectstack (the SKILL itself warns that an unscoped sweep would drown in sibling-repo queue cards). The board design says "objectui enters the board via the console bundle" — but that clause has consumers and **no standing producer** on the objectui side:

- objectui's `target:v17` label exists and was used exactly 7 times (the 2026-08-06/07 release-board audit); all 7 are closed/fixed.
- Since then objectui's local backlog grew to **117 open / 48 pm:queue** with **zero** open board items — no one ever asks the binary question ("can the current RC ship without fixing this?") over that backlog, while the console ships from it.

## Maintainer ruling (2026-08-09, quoted verbatim)

The PM proposed three actions (add a producer / one-time clearing pass / fix the release-day query scope); the maintainer ruled 「1 补上生产者」 and then 「三个动作都创建issue」 — file all three as issues. This card is action 1; siblings are filed separately and cross-linked.

## Deliverable

Amend `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, 发版板 section, by PR (taxonomy evolves by PR):

1. **Producer scope becomes "exactly one producer per backlog"** (same single-producer discipline, scoped correctly): the objectstack triage seat keeps producing for the main backlog; the **objectui whole-repo seat** produces `target:v17` for objectui's own local backlog, applying the same binary criterion + four blocking classes during its local backlog sweep. Other execution seats still never add/remove the label; mislabels go through escalation.
2. Record the stock-clearing posture: objectstack was cleared once on 2026-08-06 (309 → 46); objectui's stock gets one equivalent pass (companion issue), after which both sides are incremental-only, never full-rescan.
3. The sibling-repo line points at the new producer, and notes the release-day inventory is two queries (see the companion query-scope issue).

Guardrail note: this is a `.claude/` internal-tooling PR — per the standing exception it may be implemented by a PM seat only with the maintainer authorization quoted in the PR body, and review requires another seat or a maintainer walkthrough; no self-review-self-merge.

No `domain:*` label applied — routing is the triage seat's single-producer territory.
